evaluation.inputs: Bitget public 1h candles and funding history for the 16 symbols and BTC, fetched once after the window closes, sha256 of every file recorded before any figure is computed
evaluation.runs: once; a second run refuses while a result exists
evaluation.status_before_close: counts only: days recorded, days missed, episodes closed, weeks elapsed, chain verifies yes/no, drawdown limit breached yes/no; never a return

mode: paper only: nothing is placed on any venue, mainnet or testnet; no key is read

paper_execution.decision: once per UTC day, from the daily bar that closed at 00:00 UTC (built from closed 1h bars)
paper_execution.fill_price: close of the Bitget 1h candle 00:00-01:00 UTC of the same day
paper_execution.funding: every settlement Bitget published for the symbol, on the notional held at the settlement time (longs pay a positive rate, receive a negative one)
paper_execution.start_book: flat, equity 1.0 (returns are fractions; no amount of money is implied)

pass_rule.anchor_coverage: >= 95% of window days have their chain head published outside the server that day
pass_rule.book_net: book equity at window close, open episodes marked at the final close, > 1.0
pass_rule.expectancy: mean episode net P&L / book equity at the episode's open, after fees, slippage and funding: mean > 0 AND the 5th percentile of a weekly-block bootstrap (blocks = ISO week of episode close, 10000 draws, seed 7) > 0
pass_rule.live_coverage: >= 95% of window days have a chain entry read at or before 01:00 UTC
pass_rule.replay_match: >= 99% of covered days' targets and trades equal the replay from public data at the pinned commit (weights within 1e-6)
pass_rule.stress: the same mean, with fee and slippage doubled, > 0

strategy.name: H1b daily trend sleeve, long only (the preset 'daily trend', pre-registered 30-day sizing; not the B1v testnet overlay)
strategy.rebalance: per market, with w = held notional / book equity at the 00:00 UTC mark and t = read_book target weight: exit when t == 0 and w > 0; enter when w == 0 and t > 0; otherwise trade to t only when |t - w| > band * w; an unread market is neither traded nor dropped
strategy.venue_and_prices: Bitget USDT-M perpetuals, public candles and public funding history

trade_definition: a holding episode in one market: opens on the fill that takes its weight from 0 to above 0, closes on the fill that returns it to 0; every fill, fee, slippage and funding in between belongs to it

window.closes: the first Monday 00:00 UTC on which at least 26 weeks have passed AND at least 150 episodes have closed, by the counts-only status
window.early_stop: the window closes as FAIL on the first daily mark at which drawdown exceeds the limit
window.open_shift_rule: if the paper writer is not running on the paper process by then, the window opens on the first Monday 00:00 UTC after it is, named in an addendum sealed before that Monday; nothing else may change
